metadata.name: U.S. goods imports, exports and balance by country or area
metadata.title: U.S. goods imports, exports and balance by country or area
metadata.notes: Goods only, Census basis, not seasonally adjusted. Country/area codes retained as text. Country groups overlap member countries and must not be summed together. Source IYR/EYR annual columns omitted to avoid double counting. Balance is exports minus imports using decimal arithmetic; raw workbook retained. All-zero future months after 2026-09-01 excluded; latest populated source month cross-checked against Census/BEA BOPTEXP.
metadata.citation: US Census Bureau, U.S. goods imports, exports and balance by country or area (CENSUS_GOODS_TRADE_COUNTRIES), observations 2006-11-01 to 2026-09-01, saved 2026-11-16. Original source: https://www.census.gov/foreign-trade/balance/index.html
